_meta.role: Embedded Software Engineer I - Project Based

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate (May 2026) from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on embedded real-time systems experience across STM32 bare-metal C, FreeRTOS, and UART/I2C/SPI protocol design. Built multithreaded RTOS firmware for a Jetson-STM32 object-tracking turret and a Cortex-M4 temperature monitor with deterministic 1 Hz sensor sampling, and developed ROS2-based robotic arm control validated against MoveIt/RViz. Writes clean, testable C/C++ following SOLID principles across distributed embedded pipelines.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Built a voice-controlled pick-and-place system over a 3-layer pipeline: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller over WebSocket.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Delivery Drone
bullets: Architected a 4-layer distributed system (Flutter app, Flask/Socket.IO server, Jetson Orin Nano ROS 2 Humble, Arduino flight controller over Bluetooth) for voice-activated autonomous micro-delivery.
Deployed a Linux systemd service on Jetson with SIGTERM/SIGINT handling, WebSocket auto-reconnect, and serial passthrough to hardware.
Built Arduino flight controller in C++: PWM throttle mapping to 4x 30A ESCs, Bluetooth command parser, and per-motor override.
